findings.F1: The book earns on long holds, not on the plan's 3-day horizon: the 1,489 trades held 3.5 days or less lost a mean of −2.29 % net (sum −3,406 %), while the 821 trades held more than 6.5 days made a sum of +12,321 % (mean +10.3 % for 7 to 10 days, +21.5 % for 11 to 20 days, +16.2 % beyond 20 days); the median trade is −0.13 % and only 48.9 % of the 3,105 trades win.
findings.F2: The book's gain sits on a few days: its 20 best days carry 86 % of its summed daily return, and without them its mean daily return falls from 6.82 bp to 0.97 bp.
findings.F3: Most of the gain is timing, not the market's own rise, but it is uneven across coins: timing per bar is +13.1 bp for XRP, +6.8 for ETH, +5.2 for BTC, +5.1 for ZEC, +0.6 for LTC and −0.6 for XMR, against a market part of 1.3 to 3.4 bp.
findings.F4: The book's regime gives its edge over longer horizons, and it loses when it is rarely in it: on non-overlapping cases, the coin's excess return in the 'trending' regime minus outside it is +0.51 % over 3 days (t 2.02), and +1.73 % against −0.72 % over 10 days (t 2.57, 499 trending cases). The book lost in 2018 (−3.2 bp a bar) and 2022 (−7.9 bp, in a position only 23 % of the time).
findings.F5: A coin's 20-day return scaled by its volatility grades its excess return over the next 10 days: the slope is +0.99 % per unit (t 2.55, 1,403 non-overlapping cases), and over 5 days +0.46 % (t 2.44, 2,843 cases). The top quintile gains +2.38 % over 10 days while the other four quintiles lie between −0.23 % and −0.68 %.
findings.F6: Inside the regime (60-day and 5-day returns positive), the 5-day rise alone grades the next 3 days: the upper half minus the lower half is +1.66 % (t 3.80, 1,651 cases). Over 5 days it is +1.54 % (t 1.98).
findings.F7: The day's range multiple adds almost nothing. Inside the regime its rank correlation with the excess return is 0.061 over 3 days (p 0.08), 0.020 over 5 days and −0.051 over 10 days. Its upper half minus lower half is +0.08 % over 5 days (t 0.10). The tested idea's own size is only 0.020 of a usual move (+0.20 %, t 0.68, 825 days).

ideas.idea: The larger a coin's 20-day return relative to its daily volatility over those 20 days, the more the coin rises over the next 10 days.
ideas.consequence: A coin with a strong volatility-scaled 20-day rise is a reason to hold it long for about ten days, and a weak or negative one is a reason to stay out.
ideas.name: 20-day trend carries ten days

ideas.idea: While a coin's 60-day return is positive, the larger its 5-day rise, the more it rises over the next 3 days, whatever that day's range.
ideas.consequence: Inside a 60-day uptrend a sharper 5-day rise is a reason to join the move for a few days, and the day's range is no reason to change that bet.
ideas.name: short rise in uptrend continues
